candidates.title: Plan or Retrieve First? A Scale Study of Tool Discovery Architectures
candidates.summary: Tool-augmented LLM agents discover relevant APIs from large registries before planning execution, yet finite context windows prohibit injecting all tool definitions into a single prompt.
